background.value: uniform bright (white) background with even lighting

head_height.value: face occupies 70-80% of the photo, from crown to upper shoulders

file_spec.value: online: minimum 768 x 1004 pixels, max 2.5 MB, 35x45mm proportions

glasses_policy.value: corrective glasses permitted if eyes visible and frames do not cover eyebrows, no lens glare; dark glasses only with disability documentation; contact lenses allowed if they do not change natural eye appearance

ears_visibility.value: religious headwear must leave entire face oval and ear line visible

face_visibility.value: visible eyebrows, eyes, and pupils; face not obscured by hair

headwear_policy.value: not allowed; religious headwear permitted with faith community certification if entire face oval and ear line remain visible

accessories.value: jewelry permitted if it does not obscure face oval or disrupt background uniformity

size.evidence: The official Polish government page at gov.pl/web/gov/zdjecie-do-dowodu-lub-paszportu (fetched directly) explicitly states for passport photos: 'kolorowe zdjecie na papierze w formacie 35 x 45 mm (szerokosc x wysokosc)' (color photo on paper in 35 x 45 mm format, width x height). The same dimensions apply to both dowod osobisty (ID card) and passport. Multiple independent sources (visafoto.com, fylite.com, 123passportphoto.com) all confirm 35 x 45 mm.
